processes.title: Password reset through the help desk
processes.trigger: The user cannot sign in and phones the help desk
processes.preconditions: The user can prove their identity to the agent
main_flow: The user phones the help desk.
The agent verifies the user's identity.
The agent sets a temporary password.
exceptions: Identity cannot be verified: the call ends without a reset.
processes.result: The agent sets a temporary password and reads it to the user

processes.title: Self-service password reset
processes.trigger: The user asks to reset a forgotten password
processes.preconditions: The user can read email at the account's address
main_flow: The user enters their email address (FR-AUTH-001).
The system issues a reset token and sends the link (FR-AUTH-001, SR-001).
The user opens the link and sets a new password (FR-AUTH-002).
alternative_flows: The address has no active account: the same response is shown and no email is sent.
exceptions: The link is expired or used: it is rejected and the password is unchanged (RULE-001).
processes.result: The user signs in with a new password they chose
differences: The user chooses the new password; no temporary password is read out.

entities.name: Account
entities.purpose: A registered user's access to the portal
relationships: Has zero or more reset tokens (ENT-002)
entities.permissions: Only the account holder can change its password

entities.name: Reset token
entities.purpose: Proof that a reset was requested for an account
entities.permissions: Created by the system; redeemed only by the holder of the link
